component.name: MoldSign
MoldSign
component.summary: Sign and verify documents with the Moldovan eID card
Semnează și verifică documente cu buletinul de identitate

description.p: MoldSign signs documents with the qualified certificate on the Moldovan electronic identity card (IDEMIA CosmoX ID-A) through a USB smart-card reader, and verifies signed documents offline.

ul.li: PDF documents are signed as PAdES-T, accepted by msign.gov.md
Other files are signed as detached XAdES (BES, T or C)
Verifies PAdES and XAdES signatures, timestamps and the certificate chain
Browser connection compatible with the MoldSign Desktop protocol, with consent before every signature
Optionally remembers the PIN in GNOME Keyring, per card; never retries a PIN automatically

description.p: MoldSign semnează documente cu certificatul calificat de pe buletinul de identitate electronic al Republicii Moldova, printr-un cititor de carduri USB, și verifică documente semnate.
First GNOME build: signing, verification, activity, card details, browser connection.
